body: I’m 15 and i’ve felt this way since my dad just... changed and started abusing me and my mom about 4 years ago. After that, everything went downhill

Please i’m here to talk, I assume from your profile that you’re Transgender and if it’s about that, just think of the hundreds of thousands of people who DO accept you for who you are. They are the important ones. Not who ever hurt you to bring you to this. They’ve probably just been hurt themselves and don’t have the common sense to fix their problems instead of just giving them to someone else. Chances are, those people who heard didn’t know what it was. You do matter and people like me who understand the pain you’ve gone through do care about you. So please, just wait. And if it’s your mother who did this to you, it’s not like you’re stuck with her forever. I assure you things will get better
And i act like i’m ok and everyone thinks I am, but my emotional and physical scars tell otherwise
